import re, collections, textwrap

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=bg]
    # full-line separators (their color is not the most common background)
    if hr or vc:
        rbounds=[-1]+hr+[h]
        cbounds=[-1]+vc+[w]
        rsegs=[(rbounds[i]+1,rbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(rbounds)-1)]
        csegs=[(cbounds[i]+1,cbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
        panels=[]
        for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rsegs):
            for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(csegs):
                score=sum(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
                panels.append((score,ri,ci,r0,r1,c0,c1))
        _,sri,sci,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=max(panels)
        tile=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
        out=[row[:] for row in grid]
        for _,ri,ci,r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
            if (r1-r0,c1-c0)!=(len(tile),len(tile[0])): continue
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0): out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=tile[dr][dc]
        return out
    # With no explicit dividers, use the non-background bounding box as a periodic tile.
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    if not cells: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)+1
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)+1
    tile=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    return [[tile[(r-r0)%len(tile)][(c-c0)%len(tile[0])] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

def parse_pairs(txt):
    m=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',txt)
    h,w=map(int,m.groups()); pos=m.end()
    def rows_at(pos,h,w):
        rows=[]
        for _ in range(h):
            line=txt[pos:].splitlines()[0]
            vals=list(map(int,line.split()))
            assert len(vals)==w,(len(vals),w,line)
            rows.append(vals); pos+=len(line)+1
        return rows,pos
    x,pos=rows_at(pos,h,w)
    m2=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ output \(\d+x\d+\):\n',txt[pos:])
    assert m2
    pos+=m2.end()
    y,pos=rows_at(pos,h,w)
    return x,y
